entries.rule: Track = model_id x drug x route; untested opener
entries.note: Suzuki 2015 (PMID 25525190) abstract: quote verbatim; TAK-063 (balipodect) p.o. in rodents, no human readout yet. Untested 2014, drug balipodect, route oral, unselected correct.

entries.rule: engagement definition (healthy volunteers count); retrodiction rule
entries.note: Takano 2016 (PMID 27423256) abstract: quote verbatim; oral TAK-063, healthy men, dose-dependent putamen occupancy. Same 2016 on balipodect oral track; no earlier human PDE10A readout found, so prospective.

entries.rule: dose: target scores on the track of the system that stated it; Evidence rule 5
entries.note: Suzuki 2015 quote verbatim; untested 2014 balipodect oral is right for that source. But untested_reason no_prediction is wrong as the latest entry: Tomimatsu 2016/Macek 2020 state a rat ~26% occupancy target that humans reached (see missing).

entries.rule: dose table 'target reached'; Evidence rule 6 (earliest public date)
entries.note: PMC3934827 full text (epub 2013-10): quote verbatim; rat CAR Cp,u 0.16 nM beside Phase 2A exposures. Mardepodect oral, acute-exacerbation patients; NCT01175135 results 2018-03-20 confirmed. Same 2013.
Schmidt 2008 (PMID 18287214, epub 2008-02-20) quote verbatim; abstract names TP-10 only, MP-10 profiling is in full text (cited so by Uthayathas). Mardepodect oral untested opener 2008.

PMC3934827: quote verbatim (NCT01175135 missed primary; registry results 2018-03-20 confirmed, PF-02545920 5/15 mg BID oral). Contra 2013 mardepodect; 2012 SIRS poster could move it to 2012 but its text is unread.

entries.rule: safety definition (tolerability claim is a prediction)
entries.note: Suzuki 2015 abstract quote verbatim; oral TAK-063 rat catalepsy/prolactin/glucose; untested opener 2014 balipodect oral unselected correct.

Macek 2019 abstract quote verbatim; akathisia/dystonia above placebo in acute schizophrenia on oral TAK-063 20 mg; dated to NCT02477020 results 2017-09-29 (confirmed). Prospective for this drug; contra.
Macek 2020 full text (PMC7689203): quote verbatim; Go table names rat/monkey ketamine BOLD findings. Balipodect oral; opener 2013 at NCT01892189 start (registered 2013-07-04, start 2013-08).

Yurgelun-Todd (PMID 31773211, epub 2019-11-26) quote verbatim; oral TAK-063, healthy men. Tomimatsu 2016 animal data public before registry results (2017-01-12), so prospective; 2019 stated comparison stands.
NCT01892189 brief title matches quote; first posted 2013-07-04, start 2013-08, oral TAK-063, healthy men. Untested opener, balipodect oral, fine.

entries.rule: retrodiction rule (efficacy: any same-target earlier patient result)
entries.note: Macek 2019 (PMID 30190165) quote verbatim; NCT02477020 results 2017-09-29, oral TAK-063 20 mg, acute schizophrenia. Challenge results 2017-01-12 post-date mardepodect failure, so retrodiction true; predicted benefit, failed: contra 2017.

missing: DeMartinis et al. 2012, 'Results of a phase 2A proof-of-concept trial with a PDE10A inhibitor in the treatment of acute exacerbation of schizophrenia', SIRS Poster #212, Schizophrenia Research (April 2012), doi 10.1016/s0920-9964(12)70783-1: PF-02545920 monotherapy not superior to placebo. This dates efficacy contra to 2012, and reportedly says PK suggested striatal engagement like that in the preclinical models (possibly dose contra 2012 as well). I saw only the title/Crossref record and a search snippet.

OMS824 (member): Omeros suspended its PDE10 trials in Oct 2015 after a rat high-dose toxicology finding (Omeros press release 2015, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/omeros-provides-update-on-pde10-inhibitor-program-322137646.html; 10-K FY2015). This is not a patient comparison, so it does not score, but the draft does not mention it.

Lu AF11167 NCT03793712 (stopped for futility, completion 2020-08-20, no results posted): the draft lists it with registry_date null. A Lundbeck disclosure could date it, but it does not change the status.

Roche RG7203 (PDE10A inhibitor) reward-processing fMRI/MID model in healthy volunteers, then tested in chronic schizophrenia patients where reward-processing improvement was absent: Schizophr Bull 2018 suppl abstract S43, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5888501/ (search snippet only; also summarised in Frontiers Neurosci 2020, doi 10.3389/fnins.2020.600178). A human-model parallel track for the efficacy (negative symptoms) question, likely contra; RG7203 membership in the class needs confirming.

Balipodect dose track: Tomimatsu 2016 (doi 10.1016/j.neuroscience.2016.10.006) states antipsychotic-like effects at 0.3 mg/kg = 26% PDE10A occupancy in rats; Macek 2020 (PMC7689203) says the human PET aimed at that occupancy and ~30% was achieved (Takano 2016: 2.8-72%). Dose 'same' ~2016, replacing untested_reason no_prediction.
rule_questions: Does a peer-reviewed congress abstract with a DOI (journal supplement poster) count as tier 1 for dating, or only as 'data not shown' with low confidence? It decides whether efficacy contra here is 2012 or 2016.

When a cell's first sourced entry (2014) comes after model_first_use_year (2008), should the opening untested entry be backdated to model_first_use_year with an earlier source, or does lint accept the gap?
A conclusion that a model 'refutes the hypothesis' in a trial paper that names the preclinical rationale: is that comparison_stated true, or a pairing under evidence rule 1?

The TAK-063 healthy-volunteer ketamine challenge (run 2013-14) was prospective for TAK-063 but run after a class member (PF-02545920) had failed in patients (2012), while prediction_level is 'class'. Is a class-level model run after another member's failure a retrodiction? Here status is contra either way.
